Switching between 10 different apps just to get one task done? A work OS can turn your chaotic workflow into a central hub. It’s an open, flexible platform that centralizes your people, projects, data, and knowledge in one place. 

Ready to find out what Slack can do for your team?
👉 Visit the Slack website to learn more: https://slack.com/

The Problem: App Fatigue
Most teams lose hours every week jumping between spreadsheets, chat apps, and project tools. Information gets buried, and productivity stalls.

The Solution: A Work Operating System
A work OS is like the connective tissue of your business. It’s an open, flexible platform that centralizes your people, projects, data, and knowledge in one place. No more hunting for files — just work happening where it should.

Key features include:
1. Central hub: Connect all your favorite apps (docs, CRM, dev tools) in one workspace and eliminate task-switching.
2. Automate the boring stuff: Build custom, no-code automations to handle repetitive tasks and set reminders to keep you on track.
3. Contextual collaboration: Discuss projects where you can easily bring in the data and files you need without hunting them down.

Powered by AI
With built-in AI, your work OS becomes a personal assistant that never sleeps:
1. Summarize: Get the gist of long threads or documents instantly.
2. Generate: Create content, project plans, or drafts in seconds.
3. Insights: Surface hidden data trends to make smarter decisions faster.

Stop managing your tools and start managing your work.

title: Artists describe Afrobeats in their own words - Spotify
description:
Culture in Motion follows Afrobeats as it travels from Lagos to Bogotá, tracing a generation remixing heritage into tomorrow. 

Through intimate portraits of rising Nigerian voices and Colombian artists newly fluent in Afrobeats, the film charts a living conversation across the Atlantic, where drum patterns, pidgin hooks, and barrio cadences meet. It's culture on the move: West African style, slang, and spirituality finding new homes without losing its roots. In studios and street parties, this new wave taps a shared Afro-diasporic history to make something unapologetically global, unmistakably local, and irresistibly danceable, and celebrates the kinship between Africa and Latin America.

title: Meet Thakzin Originator of 3 Step Afro House | Spotify RADAR Africa
description:
Born to a South African and Mozambican family, Thakzin’s journey began in Ivory Park, Johannesburg, where early jazz and kwaito influences, plus a deep respect for traditional percussion, shaped his signature sound. 

Get to know the South African Afro House DJ and producer as he shares how music resonates with him on a deeper, spiritual level. Thakzin’s sound is rooted in African spirituality and healing, inspired by the rhythmic power of traditional drums. 

Discover how his sound moved across borders to be enjoyed on a global stage, and how he laid the foundation for the 3 Step sub-genre of music.

title: Rauw Alejandro w/ Wisin and Ñengo Flow | Spotify Countdown To Cosa Nuestra: Capítulo 0
description:
“Every time I drop an album I’m like, ‘This is my best album.’ It’s because you keep leveling up,” says Puerto Rican superstar Rauw Alejandro, who returns with Cosa Nuestra Capítulo 0, a bold new record that puts the Caribbean sounds forward.

Shot at El Refugio in Río Piedras, Rauw sits down with Puerto Rican legends Wisin and Ñengo Flow to reflect on the making of the album, unpacking its inspiration, his evolution as an artist, and the importance of identity. Breaking down the prequel concept, he explains how Cosa Nuestra centered on the story and sounds inspired by Puerto Rican migration to New York. With Cosa Nuestra Capítulo 0, the focus shifts to a project that pays homage to Caribbean culture at its core, anchored in the Caribbean connection.

A conversation between three generations of Latin music, shared between laughs and a game of pool, offers a glimpse into how Rauw Alejandro has matured as an artist and how legends such as Wisin and Ñengo Flow see him as an important force for today’s generation.

title: Trueno & Leandro Paredes Discuss TURR4ZO | Watch Countdown To on Spotify
description:
“I need to experience things so I can write later. I need to nurture myself to learn so that it inspires me at some point… what I experience is more important than what I write, because if I don’t experience anything, I can’t write anything,” says Trueno, who returns with TURR4ZO, a project shaped through lived experience and a deeper connection to his roots.

Shot at El Obrero, a historic dining spot in La Boca, the neighborhood where he was born and raised. Trueno sits down with Argentine professional footballer Leandro Paredes to reflect on the making of the album, unpacking its direction, his evolution, and the responsibility that comes with representing Argentina on a global stage. Drawing parallels between music and sport, the conversation centers on cultural impact and what it means to be a voice for a new generation.

Breaking down the creative process, he explains how TURR4ZO leans into classic Argentinian and Uruguayan influences and samples, a shift from the U.S. hip hop influences that defined his earlier work. He also speaks on the significance of the number 4, framing it as a defining element of the project and the album he connects with the most.

Presave TUR4ZZO out on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/prerelease/3WZjBRPv6UO3qamlkqrPoE?si=991de0da0d18414e

Listen to Trueno on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/1mcTU81TzQhprhouKaTkpq?si=-8eN4SYtT2mhxnpnqPpPOg

“Necesito vivir cosas para poder después escribir necesito nutrí y conocer para que eso me inspire en cierto punto….lo que vivo es más importante que lo que escribo por que si no vivo nada no puedo escribir nada”, dice Trueno, quien regresa con TURR4ZO, un proyecto construido desde la experiencia y una conexión más profunda con sus raíces.

Filmado en El Obrero, un bodegón histórico en La Boca, el barrio donde nació y creció, Trueno se sienta con el futbolista argentino Leandro Paredes para reflexionar sobre la creación del álbum, hablando sobre su dirección, su evolución y la responsabilidad de representar a Argentina a nivel global. Haciendo paralelos entre la música y el deporte, la conversación se centra en el impacto cultural y en lo que significa ser una voz para una nueva generación.

Al hablar del proceso creativo, explica cómo TURR4ZO se apoya en influencias y samples clásicos argentinos y uruguayos, marcando un cambio versus las influencias del hip hop de Estados Unidos que definieron sus proyectos anteriores. También habla sobre el significado del número 4, viéndolo como un elemento clave del álbum y el proyecto con el que más se identifica.

title: Making these PSL-inspired crepes ASAP. 🎃🍂 Recipe in the description.
description:
Ingredients: 
2-2.5 cups coffee-steeped whole milk
1.5 cups all-purpose flour
2 tbsp melted butter
3 tbsp sugar
4 eggs
1/4 cup pumpkin puree
1 tsp pumpkin spice 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
Pinch of slat 

1. Whist all the ingredients in a bowl, making sure there are no streaks or lumps. Consistency should be like heavy cream. Add 1/2 cup of milk if too thick. 
2. Cover and refrigerate for 30 min-1 hour
3. Heat nonstick pan to medium hear and brush with a little oil. 
4. Ladle batter into pan while swirling with your other hand to make sure the batter covers the entire surface in a very thin layer. 
5. Cook the crepe for 1-2 minutes until edges just start to crisp up. Optional to add a little butter to the pan. 
6. Flip very carefully with a flat spatula or your hands by grabbing the corner of the crepe. 
7. Repeat with the rest of the batter. 
8. For the cream: mix 1 cup heavy cream with 1 tbsp powdered sugar, a dash of cinnamon and a splash of vanilla extract. Whisk until still peaks and roll on top of your crepes. 
Dust with pumpkin spice and enjoy.

1 teaspoon green cardamon pods
4 cups water

title: Starbucks: Brewing Innovation, Nurturing Human Connection
description:
In its early days, Starbucks offered a simple menu featuring café lattes, macchiatos, and espressos. It was during this period that Starbucks became a "third place" where people could relax, enjoy music, and engage in conversations. This experience resonated with customers and started a growth trajectory that surpassed all expectations. However, Starbucks' success isn't just about coffee; it's also about fostering sustainability of the entire coffee supply chain, from seed to cup. More than 25 years ago, Starbucks introduced the Coffee and Farmer Equity (C.A.F.E.) Practices, a verification program emphasizing economic transparency, social responsibility, environmental leadership, and coffee quality. C.A.F.E. Practices have uplifted farmers' lives and promoted responsible coffee cultivation. At Starbucks, innovation isn't limited to store products but extends to enhancing the retail partners’ ability to create magical connections in 36,000 stores worldwide. The Tryer Center, an innovation incubator based inside Starbucks headquarters, brings together designers, scientists, engineers, and baristas from area stores to identify problems and create solutions. This collaborative approach, which includes ideation, prototyping, and refining, ultimately leads to better customer experiences.

*Originally aired on CBS News as part of the Innovators and Disruptors series. Can also be found on GlobalThoughtLeaders.org

Learn how to create a quick-booking form for your services using the Wix Bookings API. In this video, you’ll build a form that lets clients quickly book an appointment for the current week. You’ll use a lightbox, text and a variety of user input elements to create and design the form. Then, you’ll create a new collection, “Pending Appointments”, to store client info and manage the status of your booking requests (i.e. pending, approved or dismissed). description:
Learn how to extract isolated Zoom video and audio feeds for broadcast using ZoomISO and professional production workflows. This production overview explains how broadcast engineers and event producers can separate participant cameras, screen shares, language interpretation channels, and audio sources, then route clean feeds into OBS, NDI, SDI, SRT, Dante Virtual Soundcard, hardware switchers, and hybrid event production environments.

0:00 — What is Zoom ISO? Isolated Broadcast Feeds Explained
0:47 — Launching Zoom ISO & Session Joining Methods

8:50 — Managing Participants, Zoom OSC, & Troubleshooting Error Logs
9:11 — Advanced Use Cases: Hybrid Events & Post-Production ISO Recording

💡 KEY TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS
- Mandatory Portal HD Preparation: A frequent integration pitfall is failing to prepare the parent container. Clean 1080p feeds (typically pulling 4 to 6 Mbps each) will not transfer downstream unless Group HD and broadcast permissions are explicitly activated ahead of time inside the Zoom account web or events dashboard portal.
- Fail-Safe Resource Optimization: Zoom ISO implements hardware guardrails to prevent mid-event host execution crashes. The platform limits system resources to 80% total utilization or a strict 100 Mbps bandwidth ceiling, altering layout quality gracefully if conditions deteriorate.
- Dynamic Video Loss Protocols: Event producers can configure deterministic behaviors if a remote speaker drops their video line or suffers a camera failure. The system lets you quickly choose between dropping to a clean black field, rendering a static broadcast test card, or reflecting a company logo seamlessly.
- Isolating Language Interpretation Layers: Zoom ISO allows producers to programmatically parse and separate real-time interpretation audio tracks (such as isolated English, Spanish, or Japanese translators). This makes it incredibly straightforward to power secondary, localized alternative live streams with perfect audio separation.
- Massive Audio Expansion via Dante: For physical console environments, pairing Zoom ISO with a Dante Virtual Soundcard unlocks an expansive 64 channels of discrete, multi-channel audio routing matrix capability, matching your physical audio boards line-for-line.

title: How to Automatically Send Certificates to Zoom Webinar Attendees
description:
Ditch the messy spreadsheets, manual email follow-ups, and tedious post-event tracking! In this tutorial, learn how to use *Certification from Zoom* to automatically reward continuing education (CE/CLE) credits, compliance verification, and custom branded certificates right inside Zoom Webinars Plus and Zoom Events.

0:00 - Introduction: Automated Zoom Certification
0:31 - Setting Completion Criteria & Credit Values
1:04 - Designing Branded Certificate Templates
1:24 - Live Tracking & Instant Certificate Delivery
1:41 - Reviewing Compliance & Certificate Analytics

*What We Cover Inside:*

• *Custom Completion Criteria:* Take control of your educational parameters. Mix and match automated rules like minimum video watch time, mandatory poll participation, or direct content access—such as downloading required training materials before credit is issued.

• *Flexible Credit Distribution:* Tailor your credit weighting systems. Award full attendance credit once all criteria are met or configure automated partial credits (up to 20 total) to accurately compensate attendees based on their real-time session interaction.

• *Drag-and-Drop Template Design:* Match your exact brand identity. Choose to modify Zoom's default layout with your custom logos, typography styles, and corporate colors, or upload an external template. Arrange dynamic variables like individual attendee names, session titles, and exact completion dates on a live preview canvas.

• *Instant Delivery & Live Tracking:* Watch Zoom handle the distribution loop silently in the background. The moment an attendee triggers the required milestone, they receive an immediate on-screen congratulations prompt with a direct download link, backed by automated follow-up email notifications.

• *Granular Compliance Analytics:* Protect your reporting accuracy. Access a dedicated post-event analytics dashboard detailing precisely who qualified for certification, their specific watch-time intervals, exact credits earned, and a breakdown of completed criteria lines.
